On the smooth K3, equality of the Weil bound for the F9 point count forces H2 eigenvalues ±3 and the F3 count fixes multiplicities 12/10. Subtraction proves each U count and zeta formula, not merely tested numerically. The 729-dimensional Galois H1, exact motivic class, genus 1569, and finite-field complement zeta are natural complete invariants, and point-freeness over three nonconsecutive extension degrees is a meaningful arithmetic boundary property.
